torch.float16.scope: CPU 小尺寸只核對對照路徑與上游梯度的算法；沒有使用 CUDA Flash。

torch.bfloat16.scope: CPU 小尺寸只核對對照路徑與上游梯度的算法；沒有使用 CUDA Flash。

recorded_efficiency.training_latency_denominator: 各 40 次更新，丟棄最初 3 次後取 37 次中位數；batch_size=8
recorded_efficiency.verification_scope: 本回合重算既有紀錄的中位數、換算、誤差與容差；沒有重跑 NVIDIA L4。

implementation_provenance.method: git log --all --format=%H -- path；逐一 git show commit:path，核對 SHA-256 與函式 AST。

configuration.upstream_gradient: Fixed seed42 Gaussian * 0.125, cast to the same dtype; no task loss/scaler/optimizer

recorded_flash.manual_reference: Identical low-precision inputs; QK matmul returns input dtype, then FP32 scaling/masking/softmax; probabilities cast back to input dtype before PV matmul. This is an explicit manual reference, not an all-FP32 oracle or a demand for bitwise equality. Both routes differentiate identical upstream values.
